<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $failureCount = 0;
    private $lastFailureTime = 0;
    private $state = 'closed';
    private $threshold = 5;
    private $timeout = 30;

    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'open' && (time() - $this->lastFailureTime) > $this->timeout) {
            $this->state = 'half-open';
        }
        return $this->state;
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'closed';
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        $this->lastFailureTime = time();
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'open';
        }
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'open';
    }
}

class DatabaseCredential {
    private $host;
    private $username;
    private $authToken;
    private $database;
    private $authMode;

    public function __construct(string $host, string $username, string $authToken, string $database, string $authMode = 'password') {
        $this->host = $host;
        $this->username = $username;
        $this->authToken = $authToken;
        $this->database = $database;
        $this->authMode = $authMode;
    }

    public function getHost(): string { return $this->host; }
    public function getUsername(): string { return $this->username; }
    public function getAuthToken(): string { return $this->authToken; }
    public function getDatabase(): string { return $this->database; }
    public function getAuthMode(): string { return $this->authMode; }
}

class AuthenticationHandler {
    
    public function deriveAuthPayload(DatabaseCredential $cred): string {
        $mode = $cred->getAuthMode();
        $token = $cred->getAuthToken();
        
        if ($mode === 'password') {
            return $this->hashPassword($token, $cred->getUsername());
        } elseif ($mode === 'token') {
            return $this->validateAndReturnToken($token);
        }
        
        throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unknown auth mode: $mode");
    }
    
    private function hashPassword(string $password, string $username): string {
        $salt = hash('sha256', $username . 'db_driver_salt_2024');
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $password, $salt);
    }
    
    private function validateAndReturnToken(string $token): string {
        if (strlen($token) < 32) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Token too short");
        }
        return $token;
    }
}

class DatabaseDriver {
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $authHandler;
    private $connection = null;
    private $connectionCache = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->circuitBreaker = new CircuitBreaker();
        $this->authHandler = new AuthenticationHandler();
    }
    
    public function connect(DatabaseCredential $cred): bool {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Circuit breaker is open - service unavailable");
        }
        
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($cred);
        
        if (isset($this->connectionCache[$cacheKey])) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return true;
        }
        
        try {
            $authPayload = $this->authHandler->deriveAuthPayload($cred);
            $result = $this->performConnection($cred, $authPayload);
            
            if ($result) {
                $this->connectionCache[$cacheKey] = [
                    'established' => time(),
                    'host' => $cred->getHost()
                ];
                $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            }
            return $result;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            throw $e;
        }
    }
    
    private function buildCacheKey(DatabaseCredential $cred): string {
        return md5($cred->getHost() . $cred->getUsername() . $cred->getDatabase());
    }
    
    private function performConnection(DatabaseCredential $cred, string $authPayload): bool {
        $packet = $this->buildAuthPacket($cred, $authPayload);
        return $this->sendPacket($packet);
    }
    
    private function buildAuthPacket(DatabaseCredential $cred, string $authPayload): array {
        return [
            'protocol_version' => 1,
            'host' => $cred->getHost(),
            'username' => $cred->getUsername(),
            'auth_response' => $authPayload,
            'database' => $cred->getDatabase(),
            'auth_plugin' => $this->resolveAuthPlugin($cred->getAuthMode())
        ];
    }
    
    private function resolveAuthPlugin(string $mode): string {
        $plugins = [
            'password' => 'mysql_native_password',
            'token' => 'auth_token_plugin'
        ];
        return $plugins[$mode] ?? 'mysql_native_password';
    }
    
    private function sendPacket(array $packet): bool {
        // Simulated network send - in production this writes to socket
        $serialized = json_encode($packet);
        if ($serialized === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Failed to serialize auth packet");
        }
        // Socket write simulation
        return strlen($serialized) > 0;
    }
    
    public function reconnect(DatabaseCredential $cred): bool {
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($cred);
        
        if (!isset($this->connectionCache[$cacheKey])) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Re-derive auth payload from original credentials - never reuse cached auth
        $authPayload = $this->authHandler->deriveAuthPayload($cred);
        $packet = [
            'protocol_version' => 1,
            'host' => $cred->getHost(),
            'username' => $cred->getUsername(),
            'auth_response' => $authPayload,
            'database' => $cred->getDatabase(),
            'auth_plugin' => $this->resolveAuthPlugin($cred->getAuthMode())
        ];
        
        return $this->sendPacket($packet);
    }
}

// Usage example showing the circuit breaker pattern with credential management
function createConnection(array $config): DatabaseDriver {
    $driver = new DatabaseDriver();
    
    $allowedModes = ['password', 'token'];
    $authMode = $config['auth_mode'] ?? 'password';
    if (!in_array($authMode, $allowedModes, true)) {
        throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported auth mode");
    }
    
    $cred = new DatabaseCredential(
        $config['host'],
        $config['username'],
        $config['auth_token'],
        $config['database'],
        $authMode
    );
    
    $driver->connect($cred);
    return $driver;
}
